facts.summary: FDA says Phase 3 trial insufficient for BLA, requires new randomized survival trial · Phase 3 · Iomab-B in relapsed/refractory AML · not yet approved
facts.indication: relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (r/r AML)

evidence.summary: the FDA has now determined that the analyses from the SIERRA trial do not adequately support a BLA filing for Iomab-B and requires an additional clinical study.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Despite the SIERRA trial meeting the primary endpoint of durable Complete Remission ("dCR") with statistical significance (p-value<0.0001)
evidence.program_discontinued: Upon conclusion of its interactions with the FDA, Actinium will seek a strategic partner for Iomab-B for the U.S.
